changes.comment: sdk-ui-metric-component: Replace monaco-editor with CodeMirror in `MaqlEditor` and `SqlEditor`. Editor callbacks now receive a single `MaqlEditorView` instead of the Monaco editor and namespace, the Monaco type re-exports (`IStandaloneCodeEditor`, `IDisposable`, `IStandaloneEditorConstructionOptions`, `IEditorContribution`, `Monaco`) are removed, `ISqlEditorApi.copy` returns a Promise and the package no longer ships a web worker bundle.
